Ravens vs Falcons DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 11 · NFL Week 5 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 11, 7:27 AM ET

Bijan Robinson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Ravens at Falcons DraftKings Showdown: 22.0 points at $11,800 FLEX, 33.0 at captain for $17,700. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Robinson is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 10.4 points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, in a game with a 43.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 25.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Robinson at captain. Drake London is the next captain in line, at 14.6%. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 21.0 routes.

Atlanta is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.25 for the Falcons and 20.25 for the Ravens.

Behind Robinson and London, the next projections are Tyler Huntley (16.9, $8,800), Derrick Henry (15.8, $11,000) and Michael Penix Jr. (15.4, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 11, 7:27 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 25.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 22.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.5 carries and 4.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 10.4 and a ceiling of 38.6. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 25.7% as the captain and 46.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake London, ATL WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Drake London holds 14.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 17.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 21.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 16.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.5 and a ceiling of 36.8. He holds 51% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.6% as the captain and 36.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tyler Huntley, BAL QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Tyler Huntley holds 11.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,200 and the 16.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Huntley averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 30.1. He holds 64% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.8% as the captain and 52.0% in a FLEX spot.

Derrick Henry, BAL RB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Bijan Robinson leads the SPAGS model at 22.0 DraftKings points for $11,800 at FLEX, or 33.0 points at captain for $17,700.

Bijan Robinson is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.
